note: The roadmap is built from the official descriptions and the cited guides. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours; Push Square says up to 300 hours. One playthrough is enough, there is no mission replay, and cheats disable trophies and saving.

advice: After the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with the binoculars from the start — 200 vehicles and 100 animals are needed for 100% later.
Do optional missions as they appear: you need any 100 for the 100% checklist, and there are far more than 100 in the game.
Keep cheats off for the whole run: they disable trophies and saving.
stages.body: Finish the story first (Chapters 1–5) and enjoy it. There are no mission gold medals, so nothing is graded while you play. Two things matter now and never again: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter (15 manual slots; there is no mission replay), and do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the only trophy that may be missable. Everything else can wait for free-roam.
stages.title: Play the story — and watch the one missable

advice: Any 70 of the 80 challenges, any 300 of the 397 stunts, any 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied.
All 12 Shooting Ranges gold (The Shootist), all 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations, all 8 large bank jobs, all 39 illegal gang operations, all 15 Target Decks.
Any 100 optional missions and any 15 of the 18 meditation spots count here — the Chapter 1 meditation is not needed for this checklist.
Work the list region by region; the in-game Progress menu tracks every counter.
stages.body: After the story, the checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and nothing in it is missable. The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests; the rest need only 70–80% of their totals.
stages.title: The 100% Completion Checklist

advice: Questlines: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton (treasure diving), Billy (Mud Club), Randy (16 sports cars), Tyrone (Jason only, Synthetic Labs), Bret (hunting, Jason only) and Cal (fishing).
Strangers & Freaks needs 8 strands, but only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed counters: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Check the trophy tracker in the game's trophy list for your Strangers & Freaks count.
stages.body: The quest givers' final missions and the stranger strands are not needed for 100%, so they are often still open after stage 2. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story — none is missable.
stages.title: Side questlines and Strangers & Freaks

advice: Launder $250,000 in marked bills (Dime on the Dollar) and spend $100,000 in shops (Treat Yo Self) — bank vaults pay up to $205,000 a robbery.
Buy all 8 garages through the Vice City Real Estate app (Little Boxes, $160,000 total), then register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app (On the Spot).
Finish the count trophies: 100 WAiNK scans, 3 card sets, 500 criminal-profile actions, and the partner trophies once you can free-roam together (Chapter 2's Coffee Break).
The four unconfirmed trophies (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) have no verified method yet — check the Sources page for updates.
stages.body: Whatever is left after the checklist is small: money trophies, garages, and the one-off stunts. Most of these pop while you work the earlier stages.
stages.title: Clean-up: money, garages and the last misc trophies
